name: In the Spotlight
source:
Emmie, a skinny corgi, spends her days trying to find her next meal. Living out of her car with her chicken Henni and running from town to town catfishing guys with the face of a model online to get free food. While it has worked so far, with hiccups here and there, she wants something better. Will she find it here, or is she doomed to fooling strangers forever due to her insecurity and inability to land a real job, and risking her sanity and well being while doing it?

[From [url=https://plantbeargames.itch.io/in-the-spotlight]Itch.io[/url]]
